name: Xinxiang Chemical Fiber Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinxiang Chemical Fiber Co., Ltd. produces and sells chemical fiber products in China. Its products include biomass cellulose filaments, spandex fibers, garment linings, and textile raw materials, which are used in textiles, apparel, and medical protective equipment. The company engages in manufacturing, dyeing and finishing cellulose fibers, synthetic fibers, yarns, threads and textiles, and further processing and sales; production, supply, sales and service provision of industrial and domestic water; new material technology promotion services; and foreign trade operations. It exports its products to India, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Italy and internationally. Xinxiang Chemical Fiber Co., Ltd…
